summary: The change adds account context to a statement-delivery error log by building the payee's decrypted, full account number into the log message. The logger masks only named fields, so this puts unmasked NPI into application logs and violates LOG-1. The passing sample control test never runs the failure path, and no approved exception covers payments logging. The process records (ticket, independent approval on head, CI on head) are in order, but the LOG-1 violation alone requires rejection.
